description: Runtime assets required by some games made with RPG Maker VX Ace
notes: This package runs the official Inno Setup installer and installs the RTP system-wide under the shared Program Files (x86) location.
Install only as a global Scoop app from an elevated PowerShell session: scoop install <bucket>/rpg-vx-ace-rtp --global.
The official EULA limits use of the RTP to playing games created and distributed by registered RPG Maker VX Ace users and prohibits redistribution of the RTP files.
This manifest downloads directly from the official RPG Maker website. The RTP archive is not included or mirrored in this bucket.
The manifest hash must be initialized with scripts/Initialize-RtpManifest.ps1 before installing or publishing the bucket.
pre_install: if (-not $global) { throw 'RPG Maker VX Ace RTP is a system-wide runtime installer. Install it with --global from an elevated PowerShell session; do not use a normal per-user Scoop install.' }

$pf86 = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86'); if (-not $pf86) { $pf86 = $env:ProgramFiles }; $existingUninstaller = Join-Path $pf86 'Common Files\Enterbrain\RGSS3\RPGVXAce\unins000.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $existingUninstaller) { throw 'An RPG Maker VX Ace RTP installation already exists outside this Scoop package. Uninstall that copy first, or keep using it without installing this package.' }
post_install: $marker = Join-Path $dir '.scoop-managed-rpg-vx-ace-rtp'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $marker -Value $version -Encoding ASCII; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Force | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $marker } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force

script: $marker = Join-Path $dir '.scoop-managed-rpg-vx-ace-rtp'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker) { $pf86 = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86'); if (-not $pf86) { $pf86 = $env:ProgramFiles }; $uninstaller = Join-Path $pf86 'Common Files\Enterbrain\RGSS3\RPGVXAce\unins000.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller) { $p = Start-Process -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList '/SILENT' -Wait -PassThru; if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "RPG Maker VX Ace RTP uninstaller exited with code $($p.ExitCode)." } } else { Write-Warning 'Scoop ownership marker exists, but the vendor uninstaller was not found. Check the RTP installation manually.' } }
